newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept brass mill output dips 0.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept brass mill output dips 0.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's brass mill output in September dipped 0.4 percent from the same month a year ago to a seasonally adjusted 99,204 tonnes, the Japan Brass Makers Association said on Tuesday.
It was the 12th consecutive month that output had declined on a year-on-year basis.
Revised data for August put production in that month at a seasonally adjusted 95,725 tonnes, off 2.9 percent year-on-year.
August brass mill shipments fell 2.3 percent year-on-year to 88,884 tonnes, while inventories were off 2.1 percent from the month before at 38,640 tonnes. -- Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-6179
